artworks.title: Sweet Peas
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a cluster of sweet pea flowers with delicate, flowing petals, rendered in fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of light to dark gray. The flowers are positioned centrally, with their stems and tendrils extending upwards. Various petals appear to be opening in different directions across most of the image. In the upper right corner, the number "6" is inscribed, and towards the bottom right, there is a signature and date.

artworks.title: Profile Head of a Woman
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 200 x 154 mm
Sheet:  269 x 204 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman's upper half in profile, facing to the right. The woman is seated with her head slightly turned, revealing her detailed facial features. Her hair is styled with a soft wave and appears pulled back. She wears a simple garment with minimal detailing. The background is plain, with subtle texture. No accessories are visible.

artworks.title: Woodsman
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a person standing in a snowy forest, shown from behind as they appear to be chopping wood. The individual is positioned with their feet apart, legs slightly bent, and left arm down; the right arm is raised holding an axe above their shoulder. The person has short, curly hair, and their head is turned slightly to the right. The clothing consists of a long-sleeved shirt, rolled-up sleeves, pants, and boots. The person is holding an axe with no visible jewelry. The background shows snow-covered evergreen trees, creating a forest setting. The artistic style of the image resembles a woodcut illustration, with textured details.

artworks.title: Le Crépuscule
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a slightly elevated perspective above water level. The horizon is high in the image, with a full moon shining above it, casting a glow over the waves. The artwork seems to be an engraved piece, with detailed lines creating texture in the water. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray. The waves closest to the viewer are subtle, leading towards calmer waters in the distance, all under the night sky.

artworks.title: The Mill Pond
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil natural scene with trees, a stream, and a forest canopy. The trees create a rhythmic pattern, and a fallen branch lies across the stream. The dense foliage and intricate tree canopy dominate the view. The artwork features detailed representations of leaves, tree bark, and water ripples with a color palette of muted browns and grays emphasizing a timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Evening Star
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated perspective of a quiet, natural scene. The horizon is high in the image, above a line of trees. The trees are silhouetted against a cloudy sky with a small star slightly left of center. The intricate etching technique creates a textured appearance in the foliage. The color palette is dominated by dark tones of black and gray. Closest to the viewer, grasses and plants are intricately rendered, leading towards a body of water in the distance. Light and shadow accentuate the textures and forms of the natural elements.

artworks.title: A New England Peddler
artworks.dimensions:
image: 244 x 163 mm
sheet:  334 x 238 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man and a young woman in a garden. The man wears a suit, including a waistcoat and a top hat, and has a beard. He looks down at the young woman who is sitting on the ground next to him. She has curly hair and is focused on her task. She wears a long dress with long sleeves and a shawl. She is using scissors and a piece of cloth for a craft. There are baskets nearby filled with items. In the background, there is a wooden house facade with foliage and the ground has grass and flowers.

artworks.title: The Day Before the Election
artworks.dimensions:
image: 453 x 355 mm (not including remarque)
plate:   565 x 431 mm
sheet:  587 x 443 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: Two men are conversing outdoors, surrounded by baskets and produce. The man on the left gestures with his right hand, while the man on the right leans back with his left hand near his chin. Their attire reflects a rural setting, with one man in a long coat and patterned pants, and the other wearing a vest over a long-sleeved shirt. The background shows a wooden structure with a thatched roof.

artworks.title: The Condemned Tenement, NY
artworks.dimensions:
image: 119 x 166 mm
sheet: 255 x 321 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an old urban street scene. The detailed line work depicts the exterior of a building with stairs leading up to a porch area, where a figure is seated. The architecture is slightly dilapidated, with visible wooden beams and a ladder leaning against the structure. The facade shows multiple windows, some shuttered, others revealing faint silhouettes within. An archway presents a view to the background where further figures are suggested in shadow. The use of hatching and crosshatching creates intricate textures and shadows, typical of etching techniques used in creating cityscapes.

artworks.title: After Glow
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a wide perspective. The horizon is prominent, showing an expansive sky. A figure stands near a tree, looking out at scattered vegetation. The brushstrokes create a detailed texture resembling pencil shading. The color palette is primarily gray. In the distance, a line of trees fades into the sky.

artworks.title: A Fashionable Woman Standing in a Park
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Dian Woodner, and Helen Porter and James T. Dyke Funds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing outdoors, looking back over her left shoulder. She wears a gown with stripes and bows, a hat with feathers, and holds a handbag in her left hand. The background features a stone balustrade, a lush garden with dense foliage, and tall trees under a clear sky with few clouds.

artworks.title: Les Petites Chaumieres
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Penn Lupovich in memory of Rita Natanson Lupovich
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is about one-third from the top, where the sky meets the distant field or water body, with a fence on the left. The brushstrokes are rough, giving a textured appearance. A group of geese is in the foreground on dark ground. Thatched-roof cottages are in the middle with smoke rising from a chimney. The color palette is monochrome in various shades of black and gray, creating a vintage and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Saint Nicholas (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over black chalk, pasted to verso of a separate drawing by Abraham Bickhart (2009.38.2.a)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dian Woodner in Memory of Her Father Ian Woodner
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person standing upright from head to toe. They are dressed in elaborate ecclesiastical robes with intricate patterns and bordered with ornate designs. The individual wears a large bishop's mitre adorned with decorative elements and holds a long staff in their right hand. Their facial features show a prominent nose, a serious expression, and they appear to be middle-aged, with a slight smile and wrinkles under their eyes. The hair is mostly covered by the mitre, except for some strands visible around the forehead. They are holding a book in their left hand, upon which are placed three spheres. The background is a blank, aged paper with some stains, which emphasizes the figure's detailed attire and ornamentation.

artworks.title: Traveler in a Mountainous Landscape at Sunset
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with hills in the distance under a rose-tinted sky. A person is seated on a rock in the foreground, and trees with lush foliage are scattered throughout. The color palette consists of soft pastels and earthy tones, with pinks, purples, and greens predominating. Brushstrokes are loose and expressive, capturing the natural textures of the scene.

artworks.title: Le Matin (Morning)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David P. Tunick
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up. She is standing upright, facing forward with slight inclination as if holding something. She has short, curly hair with a decorative hairpiece. She wears a long-sleeved dress with polka dots, a high collar, fitted bodice, and an apron. In her hands, she holds a tray with items like a teapot, cup and saucer, and a small jar. The background includes a chair, framed pictures, a doorway, and heavy drapery.

artworks.title: Sunset Over Water
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the water looking towards the horizon. The horizon is visible with dark silhouettes of boats and land formations. The sky has scattered clouds, with larger masses in the top corners. The image has a grainy texture and a monochrome palette, playing with light and shadow. The water's surface reflects light with gentle undulations.

artworks.title: Blessed Art Thou Among Women
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: There are two people in the image. The child stands in a doorway, facing forward on the left side, while the adult leans slightly towards the child from the right side of the doorway. The child has short hair and a neutral expression, wearing a dark dress with light cuffs, a large bow at the collar, and a circular buckle at the waist. The adult is wearing a light-colored garment with puffy sleeves, with styled back hair, and appears to be speaking softly to the child. The background shows a white wall with a blurred painting or tapestry, a wooden floor with a striped area rug.

artworks.title: The Manger
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with a bundle, draped in a long dress and wearing a veil. Their facial features are obscured by the veil's soft focus. The person has dark hair and appears to be indoors, with light coming through a window. The surroundings have a simple design with wooden surfaces.

artworks.title: Edge of the Woods, Evening
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund

artworks.title: Morning
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund

artworks.title: Model in New York Studio
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund

artworks.title: Telegraph Poles
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dirt path beside a river or canal, with industrial buildings visible in the distance. There are utility poles running parallel to the water. The style is reminiscent of early photography with a soft focus. The color palette is muted with shades of sepia and gray. Markings and a structure are seen in the foreground, and there is a building with "produce" signage on the left. The water is calm and reflective.

artworks.title: Alvin Langdon Coburn and His Mother
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman from the waist up. The man is positioned slightly behind the woman, resting his chin on one hand while holding a large board with the other. He has short, neatly combed dark hair, a well-groomed mustache, and a short beard. The woman is seated in front of him, wearing a large hat adorned with large flowers and a patterned band. She has light-colored hair styled underneath the hat and a relaxed expression. Her clothing appears dark with a light scarf draped around her neck. The man wears a dark suit with a high-collared shirt, and a ring is visible on his finger. The background is plain and featureless.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.medium: colored chalks on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lowell Libson in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image portrays a profile sketch of a man's head and neck. The man has distinct facial features, including a large nose, prominent cheekbone, and a beard sketched in red and grey. His eyes are closed or looking downwards, and he has long hair flowing backwards. The man's shoulder is lightly indicated at the edge of the drawing. He is not wearing any clothing. The background is a plain beige sheet of paper with some irregularities, focusing on the sketch itself.
